gold: undifferentiated embryonal sarcoma of the liver

selector.rationale: Mucinous cystadenocarcinoma best explains the decisive findings of a multilocular cystic tumor with septa, enhancing solid compartment, and nonenhancing cystic compartment, along with the presence of mucinous components and high CA125 levels.

rejected.label: Intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm, such as involvement of the bile ducts.

rejected.label: Hepatic sarcoma
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to mucinous cystadenocarcinoma and liver sarcoma.
